setup.zh: 天快亮时，窗纸响了三下：隔壁的{伴}塞进来一个还温着的煮鸡蛋。
setup.en: Near dawn the window paper taps three times: {伴} from next door pushes in a boiled egg, still warm.

recap.zh: 天亮前，{伴}隔着窗塞来一个煮鸡蛋。
recap.en: Before dawn {伴} pushed a boiled egg through the window.

en: Near dawn, three taps on the window paper.

story.zh:
天快亮的时候，窗纸上「笃、笃、笃」响了三下。小满推开窗，窗外站着隔壁的阿禾。她比小满小一岁，冻得鼻头通红，活像一根刚从地里拔出来的小萝卜；身上还沾着泥，一看便知是一大早起来，蹲在菜地里给那颗被门砸扁的白菜收尸去了。

她往小满手里塞了一样东西，温温的，是一个煮鸡蛋。

阿禾道：「我娘说，你爹昨儿半夜来我家借磨刀石，前山又空了，准是要去黑松岭。」小满道：「嗯。」阿禾道：「你别死在里头啊。」小满道：「死不了。」
story.en:
Just before dawn there came three taps on the window paper — *tok, tok, tok*. Xiaoman pushed the window open, and there outside stood Ahe from next door. She was a year younger than him, her nose frozen red as a little radish just pulled from the ground, and she had mud on her — plainly she'd been up early, crouched in the plot, laying out the remains of the cabbage the gate had flattened.

She pressed something into Xiaoman's hand, warm: a boiled egg.

Ahe said, "My mum says your dad came round in the middle of the night to borrow our whetstone. The front hills are empty again — you're going to Black Pine Ridge for sure." Xiaoman said, "Mm." Ahe said, "Don't go dying in there." Xiaoman said, "I won't."

what.zh: 天没亮，隔着窗塞给你一个煮鸡蛋：「记账，以后还我。」
what.en: Before dawn, pushed a boiled egg through your window: "Keep count. Pay me back."

story.zh:
阿禾把手缩回袖子里，一本正经地道：「那记账。一个鸡蛋。以后还我。」

小满问：「还你什么？」阿禾想了一想，道：「还我两个。」小满道：「……利息这么高？」阿禾道：「黑松岭。风险大，利息自然高。」小满道：「那你家的白菜……」阿禾面无表情地道：「那个另算。那个利息更高。」

她说完转身便跑，跑到一半，又回过头来补了一句：「记得是两个！」小满站在窗前，握着那个鸡蛋，握了很久。它比沈家灶膛里最后那一点火，还要暖和。
story.en:
Ahe pulled her hands back into her sleeves and said, perfectly serious: "Then it goes in the books. One egg. Pay me back."

Xiaoman asked, "Pay you back what?" Ahe thought. "Pay me back two." Xiaoman said, "…The interest's that high?" Ahe said, "Black Pine Ridge. High risk, high interest." Xiaoman said, "And your family's cabbage…" Ahe, expressionless: "That's a separate account. The interest on that is higher."

With that she turned and ran, and halfway turned back to add: "Remember — it's two!" Xiaoman stood at the window holding the egg, and held it a long time. It was warmer than the last bit of fire in the Shens' stove.

label.en: Push it back: your family owes rent too

exits.means: refuses the egg, gives it back

story.zh:
小满把鸡蛋推了回去，道：「你家也欠着租。」阿禾瞪了他一眼，道：「我家欠的是租，又不是鸡蛋。」小满道：「那也不要。」

阿禾把鸡蛋收回袖子里，一本正经地道：「行。那记账：你欠我一回『不要』。活着回来，连本带利，再给你。」说完转身便跑，跑到一半，又回过头来补了一句：「利息很高的！」
story.en:
Xiaoman pushed the egg back. "Your family owes rent too." Ahe glared at him. "What my family owes is rent, not eggs." Xiaoman said, "I still won't take it."

Ahe tucked the egg back into her sleeve and said, perfectly serious: "Fine. Then it goes in the books: you owe me one 'won't take it'. Come back alive, and you get it with interest." She turned and ran, and halfway turned back to add: "The interest's very high!"
